title: BronzeBright
description: BronzeBright is a lightweight and highly efficient Night Vision / Fullbright utility mod for Minecraft. It allows players to instantly toggle perfect vision in the dark with a single key press, completely eliminating the need for torches or potions during
body:
🌙 BronzeBright: See the Dark in a New Light
Are you tired of carrying stacks of torches, squinting in dark caves, or constantly brewing Night Vision potions? BronzeBright is a simple, lightweight Quality of Life (QoL) mod designed to give you perfect vision in the darkest environments.

Whether you are deep-slate mining, building massive structures at night, or exploring the Deep Dark, BronzeBright ensures you never miss a detail.

✨ Features:
🔦 Instant Toggle: Turn perfect Night Vision on and off instantly with a single, customizable keybind (Default: V).
🌑 Pitch-Black Removal: Smoothly illuminates your surroundings without breaking the game's aesthetic. Say goodbye to complete darkness!
⚡ Extremely Lightweight: Designed with performance in mind. It won't drop your FPS or cause any lag.
🚫 No Potion Particles: Grants you clean vision without annoying potion swirls blocking your screen.
🌍 Client-Side Friendly: (If applicable to your mod) Can be used on multiplayer servers without needing to be installed on the server side (Note: Always check server rules regarding Fullbright mods!).
⚙️ How to Use:
Install the mod and launch Minecraft.
Go to your Controls/Keybinds menu.
Find the BronzeBright category to set or check your toggle hotkey.
Press the key in-game to light up your world!
📥 Compatibility:
BronzeBright is fully compatible with most performance mods (like Sodium, Optifine, or Iris) and works seamlessly alongside shaders.
